CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_CHARACTER_HEIDEMARIE.de: A hero of the past and an idol of the people. She distinguished herself during the Elinad Incident, the tragedy aboard the Edenity. After retiring from her position as an Operator due to her injuries, she continued to enjoy overwhelming public support. Driven by the people's call to overcome tragedy and move toward the future, she rose to the office of mayor.
